description: This file contains the implementation of a Promise class in PHP that adheres to the Promises/A+ specification. It provides methods for creating, resolving, rejecting, and chaining promises, along with handling cancellation and waiting mechanisms.

classes.name: Promise
classes.description: Implementation of a Promise adhering to Promises/A+ in PHP, managing asynchronous operations with support for chaining, fulfillment, rejection, cancellation, and waiting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Promise with optional wait and cancel callbacks.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers to the promise, returning a new chained promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Attaches a rejection handler to the promise chain.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks until the promise is settled and returns the result or throws an exception if rejected.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise ('pending', 'fulfilled', or 'rejected').

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise if it is pending, invoking the cancel callback if provided.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Internal method to transition the promise to fulfilled or rejected state, handling handlers and forwarding.

methods.name: callHandler
methods.description: Internal static method to invoke handlers for resolved or rejected promises.

methods.name: waitIfPending
methods.description: Internal method to wait for a pending promise to resolve or reject.

methods.name: invokeWaitFn
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the wait callback.

methods.name: invokeWaitList
methods.description: Internal method to invoke wait on all promises in the wait list.
